\begin{example} \end{example}[Porous Medium Equation]

↗ def:kth-order-pde ↗ def:linear-semilinear-quasilinear-fully-nonlinear

1. ch1:1.2.1.b.10\group Examples of PDE

\[ u_t - \Delta (u^\gamma ) = 0. \] For a classical solution, an equivalent form is \[ u_t - \gamma u^{\gamma -1}\Delta u - \gamma (\gamma -1)u^{\gamma -2}|Du|^2 = 0, \] which is second-order quasilinear. The corresponding general nonlinear-diffusion form is \[ u_t - \varphi '(u)\Delta u - \varphi ''(u)|Du|^2 = 0 \] with $\varphi (u)=u^\gamma $. \end{example}
